incidents.title: UN urges support for Afghan women amid tightening Taliban curbs
incidents.blurb: By David BrunnstromAug 14 (Reuters) - The United Nations appealed to donors on Friday not to cut funding for women's programs in Taliban-ruled Afghanistan, saying this would add to suffering in a country where conditions for women are already the worst in the world.
